items.name: Walmart
items.headline: Reports Q3 FY2027 revenue of $188.8 billion and raises its fiscal 2027 outlook
items.thesis: Walmart reported third-quarter fiscal 2027 revenue of $188.8 billion, up 5.2% as stated in the release, and GAAP EPS of $0.62; adjusted EPS was $0.65. Global eCommerce grew 17% and the company said it is raising its fiscal 2027 outlook.

items.name: Bath & Body Works
items.headline: Reports Q3 results and raises full-year net sales outlook
items.thesis: Net sales of $1,577M were down 1.0% from $1,594M; diluted EPS was $0.19 versus $0.37, and adjusted EPS $0.26 versus $0.35. The company raised its full-year net sales outlook to a decline of 3.4% to 2.1% and announced a new $500M buyback program.

items.name: Target
items.headline: Reports Q3 net sales of $27,067 million, comparable sales up 5.6%
items.thesis: Target reported Q3 2026 net sales of $27,067 million versus $25,270 million a year earlier, with comparable sales up 5.6%. GAAP diluted EPS was $2.65 versus $1.51, including $0.50 from tariff refunds, and full-year EPS guidance is $10.65 to $11.40.
items.source_name: Target Corporation Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Exhibit 99)

items.name: Lowe's
items.headline: Reports Q3 sales of $22.8 billion, comparable sales up 1.8%
items.thesis: Lowe's reported Q3 2026 total sales of $22.8 billion versus $20.8 billion (up 9.3% as stated in the release) and comparable sales up 1.8%. Diluted EPS was $2.98 versus $2.88; adjusted diluted EPS was $3.10, and both include a $0.34 positive impact from IEEPA tariff refunds.

items.name: TJX Companies
items.headline: Reports Q3 FY2027 net sales of $15,952 million, comparable sales up 4%
items.thesis: TJX reported Q3 FY2027 net sales of $15,952 million versus $15,117 million a year earlier, with comparable sales up 4%. Diluted EPS was $1.39 versus $1.28; excluding a $0.05 net benefit from tariff refunds, adjusted diluted EPS was $1.34.
items.source_name: TJX Q3 FY27 earnings release (SEC EX-99.1)

items.name: Palo Alto Networks
items.headline: Reports fiscal Q1 2027 revenue of $3.44 billion
items.catalyst: Fiscal Q1 2027 results (SEC Form 8-K exhibit, Nov. 18).
items.thesis: Palo Alto Networks reported fiscal Q1 2027 total revenue of $3.44 billion, up 39% as stated in the release, and GAAP diluted EPS of $0.57 versus $0.47 a year earlier; non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.05 versus $0.93. Next-Generation Security ARR was $9.73 billion, and fiscal 2027 revenue guidance is $14.52 billion to $14.57 billion.
items.source_name: Palo Alto Networks Q1 FY27 earnings release (SEC EX-99.1)

items.name: Intuit
items.headline: Agrees to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for a $3.68 billion base price
items.catalyst: Equity and Asset Purchase Agreement disclosed in SEC Form 8-K (Nov. 19).
items.thesis: Intuit entered an Equity and Asset Purchase Agreement to sell its Mailchimp business, with Intuit agreeing to invest about $368 million of the purchase price in Bending Spoons for 8,818,595 new shares. The filing says closing is expected in early calendar 2027 and is subject to HSR and other regulatory approvals, with no shareholder vote or financing condition.
